> **Template file.** Copy it to `src/content/activities/YYYY-MM-DD-title.mdx`, replace the
> frontmatter and body, then delete this one.

A dispatch reports something concrete: a research visit, a conference talk, a fieldwork session, or
a lab exchange. Open with what happened and where, then give the substance in one or two short
sections.

## What was presented

State the work, the venue, and the outcome. Cite papers by DOI rather than by journal homepage,
for example [10.1109/TASLP.2012.2183367](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2012.2183367).

## Notes

Keep paragraphs short and use lists where they help scanning:

- One point per line.
- Parameters and variables in inline code, such as `f0`.
- One to three tags per post, drawn from the standard set.

## Adding a photograph

A dispatch may carry one photograph, set in frontmatter rather than in the body. Three fields:

- **`featuredImage`** — a path to the file, resolved relative to this post. Put it beside the
  post (`./recording-session.jpg`) or in `src/assets/`. It must be committed: Astro processes
  images at build time, on a clean clone, so a file that exists only on your machine fails the
  build rather than being skipped.
- **`featuredImageAlt`** — **required whenever `featuredImage` is set**, and the build fails
  without it. Describe what is in the frame for someone who cannot see it: *"A microphone array
  on a stand facing a seated speaker"*, not *"photo from the session"*.
- **`featuredImageCaption`** — optional, rendered under the image. Factual: what it is and
  where. *"Recording session at the Language and Voice Lab, March 2026"*, not *"great week with
  the team"*.

Astro emits `webp` and a `srcset` from the source, so commit a **web-ready** file — 2000px on
the long edge and 500KB are the ceilings. Full-resolution camera originals stay in your photo
library; they are not build inputs, and git keeps every byte forever.

Photographs of the *thing* — the rig, the room, the poster, the screen — do more work here than
a posed group shot, unless the post is about the group.

## Embedding video

Video is hosted externally and embedded, so the repository stays light. Import the player in the
frontmatter of the dispatch and use it inline:

```mdx
import VideoPlayer from "../../components/VideoPlayer.astro";

<VideoPlayer
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID"
  title="Talk recording: title of the presentation"
  caption="Recording of the keynote, hosted on YouTube."
/>
```
